verdict.rationale: Atlas clearly supports equity/option-grant paperwork (vesting customization, 83(b) elections, founder equity issuance, Cooley-developed legal templates) but the evidence never mentions offer letters or confidentiality/IP agreements specifically, and community reports note Atlas doesn't eliminate the need for outside legal/accounting help for broader hiring paperwork. missing for 10: explicit support for offer letters, explicit confidentiality/IP agreement templates, independent confirmation these hiring documents are generated through the platform.
